title: RabbitFixMod
description: RabbitFixMod is a mod that fixes several bugs with rabbit models.
body:
RabbitFix is ​​a modification designed to fix a number of bugs related to the rabbit model and other things that Mojang hasn't been able to or hasn't fixed yet.

## Fixed bugs:

*   [MC-306682](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-306682) The default head angle of adult rabbits is inconsistent with that of baby rabbits and not aligned with their line of sight
*   [MC-306600](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-306600) Rabbits' heads visually face higher than their actual rotation
*   [MC-207993](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-207993) Rabbits don't follow players holding carrots on sticks
*   [MC-304535](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-304535) Rabbits are not scared of certain monsters 
*   [MC-277500](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-277500) Rabbits usually fail to raid carrot crops

Current supported MC version: **26.2**
